battery.provenance: 20Ah nominal primary. Capacity factor, OCV curve, Rpack/Rpath,20%reserve and19.2V stopping bound are explicit unmeasured sensitivity assumptions.100A=20Ah×5C published rating, not validated pack/BMS/path current or programmed protection. No physical/PX4 threshold is configured by this file.

equations.interpolation: piecewise linear thrust→reference DC power/RPM only830..1920g per rotor; below domain rejected, above maximum stops with thrust_saturation
equations.voltage_proxy: DC power at fixed thrust assumed equal to reference22.2V; conservative available thrust capped at last table point times min(1,(Vbus/22.2)^2). This off-voltage transfer is unvalidated, not a fitted motor model.
equations.electrical: Pbus=Pprop+sum(Puseful/eta); Rtotal=Rpack+Rpath; I=2Pbus/(Voc+sqrt(Voc^2-4RtotalPbus)); Vbus=Voc-I Rtotal; negative discriminant stops
equations.capacity: capacity_effective_Ah=20Ah×capacity_factor; dSoC=-I dt/(3600 capacity_effective_Ah); event step shortened to configured reserve
equations.losses: Ppack_loss=I²Rpack; Ppath_loss=I²Rpath; kept separate from bus delivered Wh. No second ESC/motor efficiency since reference electrical power already includes its test chain.

limits: Offline load-profile proxy; no Gazebo dynamics, PX4 connection, actual takeoff, position, landing or disarming observed.
Masses are synthetic sensitivity cases; they do not equal the reconciled prototype mass.
No experimental evaluation data. Synthetic evaluation profiles are separate from manufacturer calibration points but cannot qualify physical accuracy.
Exact Gemfan1555/Tekko thrust-current-RPM-torque transients and voltage/temperature dependence remain unmeasured.
No wind, drag, ground effect, tilt allocation, rotor interference, thermal, hysteresis or cell imbalance model.
Uncertainty variants are assumptions, not confidence intervals or guaranteed bounds.
Reserve excludes any separately guaranteed return/landing energy; return and landing are only bounded load phases in the simple profile.
PX4 battery source must be verified independently; simulated_battery discharge is unrelated to these results.
